paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.intro: How guests pay for paid extras across your hotel — F&B orders today, event bookings and more to come. Online payment is coming in a future update.
paymentMethods.cashHint: Always on — the guest pays in person.
paymentMethods.roomChargeHint: Charges go on the room bill; the front desk collects at checkout. Unsettled charges appear on the stay before checkout.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to payment settings
noAccess.hint: Ask a hotel admin to grant you the payment settings permission.
